Across 12 families x 6 comparators (72 tests), plain Firefly has 5 WIN, 24 LOSS and 43 TIE (Holm within family, alpha 0.05); per comparator: anova 1W/3L/8T, mi 2W/2L/8T, l1 1W/3L/8T, rf 0W/8L/4T, pca 0W/8L/4T, pso 1W/0L/11T. Mean differences range from -16.6 pts to +7.5 pts. (paired Wilcoxon, Holm within family, n=10; n = 10 seeds limits power: the smallest two-sided Wilcoxon p is about 0.002, so a Holm-adjusted WIN or LOSS needs nearly all seeds to agree.)

CIFAR-10 subset, ResNet-18 embeddings (512-d) (exploratory): mean Firefly search time ranges from 31.3 s to 422.6 s across k and budget, against 0.0594 s to 856 s for the ANOVA, MI, L1 and RF baselines; search_s measured under parallel load (meta runs: 15 workers; baselines: joblib n_jobs=-1); not idle-machine time.

Digits (64-d) (exploratory): mean Firefly search time ranges from 29.2 s to 129.4 s across k and budget, against 0.00563 s to 28.6 s for the ANOVA, MI, L1 and RF baselines; search_s measured under parallel load (meta runs: 15 workers; baselines: joblib n_jobs=-1); not idle-machine time.
